newsitem.title: UK: LME delists primary aluminium brands.
newsitem.headline: LME delists primary aluminium brands.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) said that from October 9 no further deliveries of the German primary aluminium brand HA produced by Hoogovens Aluminium Huttenwerk or Slovakian brand ZSNP produced by ZSNP AS Aluminium Works will be accepted for LME warranting.
Once stocks of these brands, warranted as of July 8, are exhausted, the brands will be delisted and will no longer be deliverable against the LME's primary aluminium contract, an LME notice said.
